properties.label: Asymmetric orbital hero
properties.text: Build a very wide black composition with compact left-aligned copy, one large thin orbital object near the centre and a sparse right-hand column of three facts, preserving generous air.

properties.label: Tracked sans and tabular mono
properties.text: Use closely tracked medium sans for the main copy and small tabular monospace for facts, creating two clear scales.

properties.label: True black and white orbit
properties.text: Use true black, a very low-contrast complete ring and one white comet arc.

properties.label: Sharp comet with separate bloom
properties.text: Separate the comet's fine bright edge from its small bloom so the arc remains sharp while the dark ring remains perceptible.

properties.label: Steady linear orbit
properties.text: Rotate the comet at a steady linear cadence while everything else stays still; pause offscreen and under reduced motion.

properties.label: Truthful fact labels
properties.text: Use real facts or mark them explicitly as sample content.

properties.label: Complete mobile orbit
properties.text: On mobile stack copy, complete ring and facts, retaining perception of the ring without making every edge glow.
